# airtelcloud_public_ip_policy_rule (Resource)

Manages a policy rule on an Airtel Cloud Public IP (NAT Gateway). Policy rules control traffic allowed or denied through the public IP.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "airtelcloud_public_ip_policy_rule" "web_traffic" {
  public_ip_id      = "b603ccb5-fe35-4ddb-9a7c-2e966a9425c2"
  display_name      = "web-traffic"
  source            = "any"
  services          = ["HTTP", "HTTPS"]
  action            = "accept"
  target_vip        = "10.1.99.172"
  public_ip         = "203.0.113.10"
  availability_zone = "S1"
}
```

```terraform
# API-shaped example (supports create_new/source_type/ip_cidr and revision_note)
resource "airtelcloud_public_ip_policy_rule" "hello_rule" {
  public_ip_id      = "b603ccb5-fe35-4ddb-9a7c-2e966a9425c2"
  display_name      = "hello-rule"
  action            = "accept"
  resource_type     = "ipam"
  revision_note     = "creating Policy"
  target_vip        = "10.1.99.172"
  public_ip         = "203.0.113.10"
  availability_zone = "S1"

  source_config = [
    {
      create_new  = true
      ip_cidr     = "1.2.1.0/24"
      source_type = "ip_cidr"
    }
  ]

  service_config = [
    {
      create_new = false
      name       = "RDP"
      is_default = false
    }
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) The action to take: `accept` or `deny`.
- `availability_zone` (String) The availability zone (e.g., `S1`, `S2`).
- `display_name` (String) The display name of the policy rule.
- `public_ip` (String) The public IP address (from the parent public IP resource).
- `target_vip` (String) The target private IP (from the parent public IP resource).

### Optional

- `public_ip_id` (String) The UUID of the parent public IP resource. Either `public_ip_id` or `public_ip_name` must be set.
- `public_ip_name` (String) The object name of the parent public IP resource. Resolved to `public_ip_id`.
- `source` (String) Flat source value (`any`, `all`, or CIDR). Optional when `source_config` is provided.
- `source_config` (List of Object) Detailed source entries (takes precedence over `source`).
  - `create_new` (Boolean) Whether to create/use a new source selector (default `true`).
  - `ip_cidr` (String) CIDR source value such as `1.2.1.0/24`.
  - `source_type` (String) Source type such as `ip_cidr` or `all`.
- `services` (List of String) Flat list of service names. Optional when `service_config` is provided.
- `service_config` (List of Object) Detailed service entries (takes precedence over `services`).
  - `create_new` (Boolean) Whether to create/use a new service selector (default `false`).
  - `name` (String) Service name (for example `RDP`).
  - `is_default` (Boolean) Whether the service is default (default `false`).
- `resource_type` (String) Resource type sent to API. Defaults to `ipam`.
- `revision_note` (String) Revision note sent to API. Defaults to `creating Policy`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier (UUID) of the policy rule.
- `state` (String) The current state of the policy rule.

## Usage Notes

- This resource does not support in-place updates. Any change to rule arguments causes replacement.
- `public_ip_id`, `public_ip`, and `target_vip` must refer to the same parent public IP mapping.
- `source_config` and `service_config` are the API-shaped input forms.
- `source` and `services` remain supported for backward compatibility.
- When both flat and detailed forms are provided, the provider uses `source_config` and `service_config`.

## Import

Public IP policy rules can be imported using `public_ip_id/target_vip/public_ip/rule_id`:

```shell
terraform import airtelcloud_public_ip_policy_rule.web_traffic <public_ip_id>/<target_vip>/<public_ip>/<rule_id>
```
